Near Mint.

 

In the first game, I somehow managed to let Legacy fall. The other heroes stuck around longer than I expected after that, with Mr. Fixer and Expatriette hanging on each at 1HP for a while...but with no way to damage the Chairman without going down to retaliation, they didn't make it.

 

Second game was the inverse, with Legacy being the only hero left standing. It went like others have described, with Legacy immune to all damage, and waiting it out and healing.

 

Legacy ended with 14HP, all others out of it.

posts.name: Griff's Dad
posts.cooked:
Near Mint, because of the hints here.

First game I just misplayed and hit the reset button out of frustration. Then I came here and got some hints. My son says I needed to join and give back, so here I am.

Second game, ended 4/19/13/2, everyone standing, because I went for Legacy Ring and Next Evolution early (like implied here). Then I got Lead from the Front out with an Irradiated Cyclohexane Vat that somehow stuck around. So everything got converted to toxic (used Legacy to take out the Supercooled Trisolvent Vat when it showed) and Legacy absorbed it all except the environment hitting the others (he had Danger Sense up third turn). Then it was just pounding all the villains as hard as possible before the last Chemical Explosion came out. I never saw motivational charge, but when the other three get time to get fully set up, they can do a lot of damage quickly.

posts.name: gossamerica2
posts.cooked:
Usually when I see The Chairman, I nope right out of it, but I decided to give it a go.  The first time, everybody but Legacy fell.  I managed to take out The Operative, and had The Charman down to 30.  I even survived a swarm of bodies coming out of the trash for a turn.  Then I made the mistake of only being immune to toxic damage, so when the Chemical Explosion took Cyclohexane out, I was in trouble and didn't last much longer.  But I didn't feel like it was a hopeless battle.z

The second time, I lost Fixer and Expat.  However, Legacy buried the Cyclohexane so AZ could heal himself and stick around, and I won with Legacy at 32 and AZ at 28 for a Near Mint.  I might even go back and try again, just to use Fueled Freeze on Bloody Knuckles...

posts.name: Gus_Smedstad
posts.cooked:
Minted this when it came out, pretty much the way most people did. Everyone fell down except Legacy, but Legacy was indestructible because of Next Evolution. When the Cyclohexane Vat came out, Absolute Zero was down to 2 HP, so I didn't destroy it. I figured that he'd get wiped no matter what I did, so it was better to keep the +1 damage and ensure that Legacy only needed to be immune to Toxic damage to ignore everything.

At the time, Legacy had no way of doing damage on his own, but Ex-Patriette was letting him do 1 damage on using a power, which meant he was still doing damage with Next Evolution. Soon enough I drew Motivating Charge, which became my main source of damage. I did have the Legacy Ring out so I could do that without giving up Toxic immunity.

Legacy's very good against the Organization even without the Vat, since almost all the damage the Organization does is melee. Get Next Evolution and Lead From the Front out soon enough and he'll tank most of the damage. My problem was that by the time I got Lead from the Front, Legacy was alone.
